justifications.r1: Mono-black ramp (Crypt Ghast, Cabal Coffers, Jet Medallion).
justifications.r2: Instant-speed reanimation of any graveyard generates massive card flow.
justifications.a1: Black tutors (Entomb, Buried Alive, Demonic Tutor) fetch key reanimation targets.
justifications.p1: Presents devastating life drain loops (Gary / Kokusho) on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: Requires 1–2 opponent untap steps, or immediate loop with sac outlet.
justifications.i1: Repeatable creature sacrifice removal and black spot removal.
justifications.i2: Repeated edicts and opponent graveyard theft strip opposing resources.
justifications.s1: Chainer life payment is an alias for mana; boots protect Chainer.
justifications.s3: Nightmare exile trigger makes Chainer removal impactful.
